meta.title: Split line items into lots and publish, creating a Master QCS per lot

plan.title: Split RFQ into lots and publish

steps.note: Open the existing RFQ event in its evaluation-stage state.

args.goal: On the RFQ event, open Settings and select Split Line Items into Lots; in Manage Lots move line items into the requested lots using the serial-number dropdowns; open each lot header and click Publish Lot; click Close in the bottom-right; stop when the screen proves the line items shifted, shows the success message "You've successfully split your RFQ into Lots", shows one Master QCS tab for each lot, and no longer shows the original unified Master QCS tab.

steps.note: Perform and verify the lot-management and per-lot publication flow that no domain step currently exposes.

args.text: You've successfully split your RFQ into Lots

steps.note: Assert the product's documented success message after the lots are published.
